Hi Shanton,

Can you modify the dissector to make a build in dissector ? and not a plugin ?

I originally considered future flexibility for adding vendor MMEs and easier management, so I used a plugin architecture instead of adding the code directly to `epan/dissectors/packet-homeplug-av.c`.

I can modify it to make a build in dissector, but I would like to confirm a couple of things first:

* Should the HomePlug AV vendor MME dissector be added directly to `epan/dissectors/packet-homeplug-av.c`?
* Is it possible to add another directory under `epan/dissectors` (for example, `epan/dissectors/homeplug-av-vendor/<vendor-name>`) to contain the HomePlug AV vendor MME dissector code?

I think it would be better to keep the vendor MME dissector code separate from the main HomePlug AV dissector for better organization and maintainability.

Yes, you can add AV vendor MME on `packet-homeplug-av.c`
and for vendor, you can make packet-homeplug-av-vendor-XXX.c 
We prefer to have only a file with all stuff (there is already a lot of file...)
I closed this merge request, after the modification are completed, I will submit a new merge request separately.

+# This script generates the name_defs.h file for the HomePlug AV SPIDCOM MMEs dissector
+
+import os
+import sys
+
+script_path = os.path.abspath(__file__)
+
+# Helper function to define names
+# This function would be called from the evaluated name_defs.py file as `_()`
+def define(name, *args):
+    fields = [name]
+    for arg in args:
+        for e in arg:
+            fields.append("{}.{}".format(name, e))
+    return fields
+
+# Function to dump the generated name definitions to output as contents of name_defs.h
+def dump(result, output):
+    prefix = "PLUGINS_EPAN_HOMEPLUG_AV_VENDOR_SPIDCOM__"
+    print(
+        "// Auto-generated by 'plugins/epan/homeplug-av/vendor/spidcom/tools/gen_name_defs.py'",
+        file=output,
+    )
+    print("/*", file=output)
+    print("* name_defs.h", file=output)
+    print("*", file=output)
+    print(
+        "* Copyright 2025 VertexCom, ShanTon Tu <shanton.tu@vertexcom.com>", file=output
+    )
+    print("*", file=output)
+    print("* Wireshark - Network traffic analyzer", file=output)
+    print("* By Gerald Combs <gerald@wireshark.org>", file=output)
+    print("* Copyright 1998 Gerald Combs", file=output)
+    print("*", file=output)
+    print("* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later", file=output)
+    print("*/", file=output)
+    print("#ifndef PLUGINS_EPAN_HOMEPLUG_AV_VENDOR_SPIDCOM_NAME_DEFS_H_", file=output)
+    print("#define PLUGINS_EPAN_HOMEPLUG_AV_VENDOR_SPIDCOM_NAME_DEFS_H_\n", file=output)
+    import collections
+
+    c = collections.Counter()
+    for line in result:
+        if line in ("homeplug_av", "homeplug_av.mmtype", "homeplug_av.mmtentry"):
+            continue
+        c[line] += 1
+        macro_name = prefix + line.replace(".", "__")
+        print('#define {} "{}"'.format(macro_name, line), file=output)
+    print("\n#endif // PLUGINS_EPAN_HOMEPLUG_AV_VENDOR_SPIDCOM_NAME_DEFS_H_", file=output)
+    for name, count in c.items():
+        if count > 1:
+            sys.stderr.write("Errror: Duplicate name definition: '{}'\n".format(name))
+            sys.exit(1)
+
+
+def main():
+    try:
+        source = open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(script_path), "name_defs.py")).read()
+        result = eval(source, {"_": define})
+        dump(result, sys.stdout)
+    except Exception as e:
+        sys.stderr.write("Exception from '{}':\n{}\n".format(script_path, e))
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+bool dissect_spidcom_homeplug_av_vendor_heur(tvbuff_t *tvb,
+                                               packet_info *pinfo,
+                                               proto_tree *tree, void *data) {
+    int tvb_remaining_len;
+    homeplug_av_vendor_context_t *ctx;
+
+    ctx = (homeplug_av_vendor_context_t *)data;
+    DISSECTOR_ASSERT(ctx);
+    tvb_remaining_len = tvb_reported_length_remaining(tvb, ctx->cursor_offset);
+
+    if (ctx->oui != HOMEPLUG_AV_OUI_SPIDCOM || tvb_remaining_len < 38) {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    if (tree == NULL) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    // find `homeplug_av.vendor` tree
+    proto_node *vendor_tree = tree->first_child;
+    while (vendor_tree != NULL) {
+        if (vendor_tree->hfinfo &&
+            vendor_tree->hfinfo->id == ctx->hf_homeplug_av_vendor) {
+            break;
+        }
+        vendor_tree = vendor_tree->next;
+    }
+
+    if (vendor_tree == NULL) {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    // get subset of `homeplug_av.vendor` tree, -3 to include OUI field
+    tvbuff_t *vendor_tvb =
+        tvb_new_subset_remaining(tvb, ctx->cursor_offset - 3);
+    dissect_spidcom_mmtype_vs(vendor_tvb, pinfo, vendor_tree, ctx);
+    return true;
+}

+all vendor specific MME dissector libraries, then link them to the plugin.
+
+The plugin provides cmake macro ``ADD_HOMEPLUG_AV_VENDOR_STATIC_LIBRARY`` (
+which is defined in `plugins/epan/homeplug-av/vendor/homeplug-av-vendor.cmake`)
+to create a static library for vendor specific MME dissector.
+
+To add a vendor-specific MME dissector, you need to do the following steps:
+
+1. Create a vendor source directory under `plugins/epan/homeplug-av/vendor`
+   (referred to as the vendor source directory in the following description)
+2. Create a `CMakeLists.txt` file in the vendor source directory
+3. Include `homeplug-av-vendor.cmake` at the beginning of the `CMakeLists.txt`
+4. Set the variable `HOMEPLUG_AV_VENDOR_LIB_FILES` to list all source files
+   of the vendor specific MME dissector
+5. Invoke the macro `ADD_HOMEPLUG_AV_VENDOR_STATIC_LIBRARY` with the target name
+   (use `homeplug-av-<vendor>` as the target name)
+6. Add the vendor source directory as a subdirectory
+   in `plugins/epan/homeplug-av/vendor/CMakeLists.txt`
+
+Needed functions & macros
+-------------------------
+
+The plugin use two header files to import needed functions & macros of vendor specific MME dissector libraries:
+
+* `plugins/epan/homeplug-av/vendor.h`:
+  collects the marcos of vendor OUI, MMTYPE field name & value string ext name
+* `plugins/epan/homeplug-av/vendor_import.h`:
+  collects the functions of vendor mmetype heuristic dissector & register function
+
+To setup an vendor specific MME heuristic dissector, you need to implement the functions
+& define the macros with specific naming rules at first.
+
+1. Implement a heuristic dissector function which names ``dissect_<vendor>_homeplug_av_vendor_heur``
+2. Implement a register function which names ``homeplug_av_<vendor>_register_process``
+   to register all fields of vendor specific MME
+3. Add above functions to `plugins/epan/homeplug-av/vendor_import.h`
+4. Define macro which names ``HOMEPLUG_AV_OUI_<VENDOR>`` with the OUI value of the vendor
+5. Define macro which names ``HOMEPLUG_AV_MMHDR_MMTYPE_<VENDOR>``
+   with the value ``"homeplug_av.mmhdr.mmtype.<vendor>"`` for MMTYPE field of the vendor
+6. Define macro which names ``HOMEPLUG_AV_MMTYPE_<VENDOR>_VALUE_STRING_EXT``
+   with the value ``"homeplug_av_mmtype_<vendor>_vals_ext"``
+7. Add above macros to `plugins/epan/homeplug-av/vendor.h`
+
+When above steps are completed, you have to invoke the register function & heuristic dissector
+in the ``proto_reg_handoff_homeplug_av`` function.
+
+The plugin provides a macro ``HOMEPLUG_AV_VENDOR_SETUP`` which
+invokes ``heur_dissector_add`` with the list name `homeplug_av.vendor`
+to register the heuristic dissector, and invokes the register function to register
+all fields of the vendor specific MME.
+
+To complete the setup, you need to invoke macro ``HOMEPLUG_AV_VENDOR_SETUP``
+with the vendor name as argument in the ``proto_reg_handoff_homeplug_av`` function.
+
+For example:
+
+.. code-block:: c
+
+    void proto_reg_handoff_homeplug_av(void) {
+        if (proto_homeplug_av != -1) {
+            HOMEPLUG_AV_VENDOR_SETUP(proto_homeplug_av, spidcom, SPIDCOM);
+        }
+    }
+
+Extra needed steps
+------------------
+
+We need to modify the `packet-homeplug-av.c` file to let the vendor specific dissector work.
+
+* Add entry to vendor OUI string table:
+
+.. code-block:: c
+
+    static const value_string homeplug_av_vendors_oui_vals[] = {
+        { HOMEPLUG_AV_OUI_SPIDCOM,          "SPIDCOMTechn" }, // add OUI entry
+        { HOMEPLUG_AV_OUI_QCA,              "Qualcomm Atheros" },
+        { HOMEPLUG_AV_OUI_ST_IOTECHA,       "ST/IoTecha" },
+        { HOMEPLUG_AV_OUI_DSPACE,           "dSPACE GmbH" },
+        { 0, NULL }
+    };
+
+* Add switch case in `dissect_homeplug_av_mmhdr` function to handle vendor OUI:
+
+.. code-block:: c
+
+    switch (*homeplug_av_oui) {
+    case HOMEPLUG_AV_OUI_SPIDCOM: // add vendor OUI case
+        hf = proto_registrar_get_byname(HOMEPLUG_AV_MMHDR_MMTYPE_SPIDCOM);
+        if (hf != NULL) {
+            ti_mmtype = ptvcursor_add_no_advance(cursor, hf->id, 2, ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN);
+        } else {
+            ti_mmtype = ptvcursor_add_no_advance(cursor, hf_homeplug_av_mmhdr_mmtype_general, 2, ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN);
+        }
+        break;
+    case HOMEPLUG_AV_OUI_QCA:
+        ti_mmtype = ptvcursor_add_no_advance(cursor, hf_homeplug_av_mmhdr_mmtype_qualcomm, 2, ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN);
+        break;
+    case HOMEPLUG_AV_OUI_ST_IOTECHA:
+        ti_mmtype = ptvcursor_add_no_advance(cursor, hf_homeplug_av_mmhdr_mmtype_st,       2, ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN);
+        break;
+    default:
+        ti_mmtype = ptvcursor_add_no_advance(cursor, hf_homeplug_av_mmhdr_mmtype_general,  2, ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN);
+        break;
+    }
+
+
+* Add switch case in `info_column_filler_initial` function:
+
+.. code-block:: c
+
+    switch (homeplug_av_oui)
+    {
+    case HOMEPLUG_AV_OUI_SPIDCOM: // add vendor OUI case
+        col_append_sep_str(pinfo->cinfo, COL_INFO, ", ",
+                           val_to_str_ext(pinfo->pool, homeplug_av_mmtype,
+                                          get_external_value_string_ext(HOMEPLUG_AV_MMTYPE_SPIDCOM_VALUE_STRING_EXT),
+                                          "Unknown 0x%x"));
+        break;
+    case HOMEPLUG_AV_OUI_ST_IOTECHA:
+        col_append_sep_str(pinfo->cinfo, COL_INFO, ", ",
+                           val_to_str_ext(pinfo->pool, homeplug_av_mmtype,
+                                          &homeplug_av_mmtype_st_iotecha_vals_ext,
+                                          "Unknown 0x%x"));
+        break;
+    case HOMEPLUG_AV_OUI_QCA:
+        col_append_sep_str(pinfo->cinfo, COL_INFO, ", ",
+                           val_to_str_ext(pinfo->pool, homeplug_av_mmtype,
+                                          &homeplug_av_mmtype_qualcomm_vals_ext,
+                                          "Unknown 0x%x"));
+        break;
+
+    case HOMEPLUG_AV_OUI_NONE:
+        /* if oui is unknown, trying to describe as general MME */
+        col_append_sep_str(pinfo->cinfo, COL_INFO, ", ",
+                           val_to_str_ext(pinfo->pool, homeplug_av_mmtype,
+                                          &homeplug_av_mmtype_general_vals_ext,
+                                          "Unknown 0x%x"));
+        break;
+
+    default:
+        break;
+    }
